build_dcnv2_extension: build the DCNv2 CUDA or CPU C++ extension module using torch cpp extension
run_setup_install: run setup.py to install the DCNv2 deformable convolutional networks package
get_extensions_cuda: get the CUDA extension modules when torch cuda is available with nvcc flags
get_extensions_cpu: get the CPU-only C++ extension modules when CUDA is not available
review_get_extensions: review the get_extensions function that configures CppExtension or CUDAExtension based on cuda availability
